== Course of events ==

The trial proceeds with the King presiding as judge, crowned and wigged in his authority. The White Rabbit announces Alice as the next witness to be called, and she stands to take her place. As she rises, her skirt catches the jury-box, and the jurymen tumble into the crowd below. It is at this juncture that Alice grows to full size and declares the court to be nothing but a pack of cards.

Alice refuses to obey when the King commands her to leave. She argues with unwavering conviction that the rule requiring her departure has been invented only in that very moment and cannot possess any legitimate authority. The King attempts to restore order by interpreting verses, yet his interpretations descend into pure absurdity with no coherent meaning to guide them. He insists, with growing urgency, that all jurymen must return to their proper places before the trial can proceed.
